# thunder_sflow_collector_custom (Resource)

`thunder_sflow_collector_custom`: Configure Custom sFlow collector

__PLACEHOLDER__

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "thunder" {
  address  = var.dut9049
  username = var.username
  password = var.password
}
resource "thunder_sflow_collector_custom" "thunder_sflow_collector_custom" {
  ipv4_addr = "10.10.10.10"
  user_tag  = "84"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Configure name of sFlow Receiver

### Optional

- `ipv4_addr` (String) Configure IP address of the sFlow Receiver
- `ipv6_addr` (String) Configure IPv6 address of the sFlow Receiver
- `user_tag` (String) Customized tag
- `uuid` (String) uuid of the object

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
